inputs: issue #2129 body and maintainer reply (github.com page, fetched 2026-11-14)
prompt:
You write the story panel. Write 4-6 plain-language sentences describing what the change does and what is and is not proven.
Every sentence must end with one or more claim references like [C1]. A sentence with no claim reference is invalid.
State facts, not opinions of quality. No confidence numbers.

sentences.text: The change answers issue #2129: a project that references MessagePack can declare a partial formatter class marked [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter], and the source generator writes the body for a type from another assembly.
sentences.text_with_refs: The change answers issue #2129: a project that references MessagePack can declare a partial formatter class marked [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter], and the source generator writes the body for a type from another assembly. [C1]

sentences.text: By default every public read-write member of the external type is written as a string key, and the seven execution tests pass on head and do not build on base.
sentences.text_with_refs: By default every public read-write member of the external type is written as a string key, and the seven execution tests pass on head and do not build on base. [C1][C2][C4]

sentences.text: An optional surrogate type with [Key] and [IgnoreMember] attributes sets the keys, and misuse is reported as MsgPack019 to MsgPack022 by six analyzer tests that fail on base and pass on head.
sentences.text_with_refs: An optional surrogate type with [Key] and [IgnoreMember] attributes sets the keys, and misuse is reported as MsgPack019 to MsgPack022 by six analyzer tests that fail on base and pass on head. [C9][C10]

sentences.text: The change ignores attributes that sit on the external type itself, although the maintainer's reply asked for attributes to win when present.
sentences.text_with_refs: The change ignores attributes that sit on the external type itself, although the maintainer's reply asked for attributes to win when present. [C3]

sentences.text: Read-only and private-setter members are dropped without a diagnostic, a second formatter for the same type is silently not generated, and the new public attribute lands in the MessagePack.Annotations runtime assembly, so the router reads the whole diff.
sentences.text_with_refs: Read-only and private-setter members are dropped without a diagnostic, a second formatter for the same type is silently not generated, and the new public attribute lands in the MessagePack.Annotations runtime assembly, so the router reads the whole diff. [C8][C11]
